data.name: Engineer Monkey
targeting_extra: Manual Targeting with Cleansing Foam or Bloon Trap (0-1-4 per fandom)
Sentry Expert spawns Crushing, Boom, Cold, Energy Sentries in order, adaptive priority
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Sentry Gun
1.text: Spawns a Sentry sub-tower in range every 10s; lasts 25s (30s with Vigilant Sentries); placed where its range covers >=20% of track if possible; attacks every 0.95s, pierce 2, range 45.

1.name: Faster Engineering
1.text: Sentry spawn cooldown 10->5s. With Cleansing Foam: foam cooldown -50%. With Bloon Trap: new trap stockpile time -50%, replacement delay -0.7s.

1.name: Sprockets
1.text: Halves nailgun and newly placed sentries' attack cooldowns (2x attack speed); not sentry deploy speed. Sentries can stun when crosspathed with Pin.

1.name: Sentry Expert
1.text: Four sentry types spawned in that order by default, adapts priority to bloons on screen. Per-type numbers not captured (crosspath Oversize Nails: +50% sentry pierce rounded up).

1.name: Sentry Champion
1.text: Champion Sentries self-destruct on expiry: pops 50 bloons (75 w/ Oversize), 100 dmg. Plasma balls pierce 5 (10), 3 dmg, cd 0.06s, range 50 (54). Engineer nail cooldown 0.35->0.3s.

2.name: Larger Service Area
2.text: All attack ranges +20 (40->60). With Sentry Gun+: sentry range +4. With Bloon Trap: trap deploy point settable anywhere in range, auto-collects after trap cooldown.

2.name: Deconstruction
2.text: Nailgun and newly spawned sentries +1 damage vs MOAB-class and +1 vs Fortified. New traps strip Fortified before trapping.

2.name: Cleansing Foam
2.text: Extra foam attack sprays target within range: removes Camo and Regrow; Lead (not DDT) loses outer layers instantly even if Fortified. All attacks 4x speed for 1s at round start.

2.name: Overclock
2.text: Ability: target another tower for +66.67% attack speed (+10% range on Villages), 30-60s by target's highest tier (30s Heroes). Main attack pierce +12 (15 total), foam puddle pierce +4 (14); nail speed x2 with halved lifespan. Ability cooldown not captured.

2.name: Ultraboost
2.text: Replaces Overclock; each use also permanently reduces tower attack cooldown 4% (Villages +1.5% range), stacking to 10 (40% cooldown / +66.67% attack speed, +15% Village range). Applies to Banana Farms' production. Doesn't stack with Overclock buff. Cd 35s, 60s on all towers/Heroes, 10 uses per round per Engineer, cooldown resets on upgrade. Main pierce +15 (30), foam pierce +10 (24).

3.name: Oversize Nails
3.text: Base pierce +5, Sharp->Shatter (pops Frozen). Crosspaths: Sentry Gun sentry pierce +1 and Shatter; Sentry Expert sentry pierce +50% rounded up; Sentry Champion plasma +5, explosion +25; foam splash pierce +5 (Cleansing), +7 (Overclock), +12 (Ultraboost). Nail radius unchanged.

3.name: Pin
3.text: Nailgun shots pin non-MOAB bloons, stunning the next layer 1s (bonus damage vs stunned applies). Sentries cannot pin unless crosspathed with Sprockets+.

3.name: Double Gun
3.text: Base attack cooldown halved (0.35s), alternates left/right guns offset 6.16 units. With Sentry Gun: sentries fire 2 parallel projectiles.

3.name: Bloon Trap
3.text: Trap collects and insta-kills bloons until it holds 500 RBE (530 w/ Big Traps), then collect for cash: +100% cash from trapped bloons (not in no-income modes). Cooldown before next trap. Not MOAB-class, not Camo unless detection before deploy. Ignores obstacles. Removed on sell/sacrifice.

3.name: XXXL Trap
3.text: Larger trap that collects MOAB-class (not BADs/Bosses), 4.6s creation cooldown, 10,000 RBE, +200% cash per pop (not in no-income modes).

paragon.name: Master Builder
paragon.requirement: Sentry Champion, Ultraboost and XXXL Trap on map at once; absorbs other Engineers; degree 1-100.
paragon.effect: Fires three nails at a time that Pin any bloon except BADs/Bosses (5s stun per hit). End of each round permanently +30% attack speed to itself. Ability 1: deploy a Mega Sentry anywhere (Green: persistent infinite-range laser, cursor-follow or lockable; Red: four plasma streams in a cone; Blue: missiles that pop any type with explosions on each collision; Green and Red weak to Purple). Each Mega Sentry spawns a temporary Modified Sentry Paragon every 6s (plasma balls, explode on sell/expiry). One of each Mega Sentry max; replacing/selling detonates it and its children. Camo detection on all. Ability 2: Overclock another tower including Paragons, 60s (15s for Paragons) plus nearby towers/sub-towers; Villages +15% range; Banana Farms +66.67% production. Numbers not captured.
